title: EarthRef SC seamount row
description: One seamount entry from the EarthRef Seamount Catalog. Mandatory fields are name + (latitude_deg, longitude_deg) for spatial placement; depth/height fields are optional because not all catalogued seamounts have measured bathymetry.

longitude_deg.description: Geocentric longitude in degrees (either signed [-180, 180] or unsigned [0, 360] convention).

summit_depth_m.description: Depth of summit below sea level, metres. Null if unmeasured.

summit_height_m.description: Height of summit above seafloor, metres. Null if unmeasured.
